Definite relative noun (nisba) composed of قُسْطَنْطِين (qusṭanṭīn, “Constantine”) + ـِيَّة (-iyya). Probably an ellipsis of اَلْمَدِينَة الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة (al-madīna al-qusṭanṭīniyya, “the city of Constantine”).
s: relative noun (nisba) composed of قُسْطَنْطِين (qusṭanṭīn, “Constantine”) + ـِيَّة (-iyya)
ellipsis of اَلْمَدِينَة الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّة (al-madīna al-qusṭanṭīniyya, “the city of Constantine”)
g: Constantinople (the former name, from 330–1930 C.E., of Istanbul, the largest city in Turkey; the former capital of the Ottoman Empire and of the Byzantine Empire before that)
